name: Camping Seehof
beschreibung: The campsite Seehof is also situated in Kramsach, right alongside Lake Reintaler See. Surrounded by verdant meadows, the park offers pitches with lake views. Amenities include modern sanitary blocks and a dedicated camper service station. An on-site restaurant treats guests to authentic regional dishes, while the lake invites refreshing swims and leisurely boat rides in Tyrol's scenic nature.
